sample.biological_model: Ex vivo DLL4-induced lymphoid progenitor (ProTcell) product
sample.biological_source: Human CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells from mobilized peripheral blood
sample.sample_material: Whole Day-7 ProTcell product from native source/product batch mPB1. Harvested after DLL4-Fc/RetroNectin culture, washed, frozen in 10% DMSO and thawed/washed before single-cell library preparation. CD7-transcript filtering is a later analysis subset, not a separate collected preparation.
